findings: Scan/cleanup handlers guard isWorking and retain scan Task handles; cancelled scans do not publish returned groups and explicitly show stopped status. This caller distinguishes cancellation even though raw scanner array API does not.
Archive/installer cleanup adds already-missing items to resolved and reports resolved.count as moved-to-Trash count, overcounting actual moves. Reclaimed bytes increment only when trash returns true.

Successful cleanup/organization/undo status is immediately overwritten by await scan status. Failed duplicate cleanup does not rescan after potentially successful earlier extra deletions, retaining stale group state.

Organization proposal records counts/bytes/categories but not frozen file IDs or content snapshots. organizeApproved recomputes approvedReadyFiles when confirmed, so an intervening rescan/profile change can alter actual plan scope.

AI Needs Review output can be promoted back to known-format category with confidence at least minimumConfidence, allowing automatic organization despite weak subject evidence. This is an explicit fallback policy, not model certainty.

Analysis stop is cooperative after current file. Pending decision save suppresses errors while status says decisions saved. Model failure restores an earlier captured record by path without verifying source identity.

teach captures a file array index, awaits profile persistence then indexes files again to save a decision; concurrent rescan can reorder/replace that index. Profile save failure also leaves in-memory edits.

Automatic routine unconditionally writes precomputed organized count after organizeApproved handles its own errors, confirming possible success text after failure/partial execution. No AppState runtime or user preferences were touched.
